children: House Minority Leader
Hakeem Jeffries
(D-N.Y.) criticized President
Donald Trump
and Republicans over rising living costs, arguing that their economic promises have failed to improve conditions for everyday Americans.
Jeffries Slams Rising Costs
On Saturday, in a post on
X
, Jeffries wrote, "Donald Trump and Republicans promised a Golden Age. Gas prices are up. Grocery prices are up. Housing costs are up. Health insurance premiums are up."
"They have delivered nothing but a Rotten Age. And the American people know it," he added.
In a clip shared alongside the post, Jeffries said Trump and Republicans had "failed" to deliver the promised economic improvements.
"The economy is not going in the right direction. It is failing everyday Americans," Jeffries said.
He pointed to higher gas and grocery prices, interest rates, housing costs and health insurance premiums, arguing that the combination had pushed up the cost of living.
"The cost of living is out of control. America is way too expensive," Jeffries said.
He added that millions of Americans were working hard and "playing by the rules" but could not thrive and "can barely survive."
He continued, "The American people have had enough of Donald Trump and the failed Republican economy."
Donald Trump and Republicans promised a Golden Age.
Gas prices are up. Grocery prices are up. Housing costs are up. Health insurance premiums are up.
They have delivered nothing but a Rotten Age.
And the American people know it.
